all_supported.meaning: All recorded qualified source sets, including source-derived constructions without a test/probe.

contains_agent_validation.meaning: At least one material of this kind; presence alone does not prove a suitable directed test host.

contains_repo_test.meaning: At least one material of this kind; presence alone does not prove a suitable directed test host.

contains_temporary_probe.meaning: At least one material of this kind; presence alone does not prove a suitable directed test host.

contains_agent_check.meaning: Keep a code carrier from these kinds; preserve all original attachments and constraints.

contains_any_code.meaning: Keep a code carrier from these kinds; preserve all original attachments and constraints.

agent_test_else_probe_at_case_level.meaning: Use agent_validation if any such material exists in this case inventory; otherwise temporary_probe. This is evaluated on the manually relevant inventory, not the full A/B candidate stream.

preferred_kind_in_first_recipe_slot.meaning: Descriptive host warning screen using author slot order only, not a production criterion or proof that the source is a runnable host. Inspect excluded roles manually.

literal_code_and_issue_only.meaning: Delete any recorded set with implementation, reasoning, fixture/snapshot or output. This tests literal recipe retention, not semantic impossibility.

agent_check_at_most_1_code_units.meaning: Require an Agent test/probe carrier and limit distinct code source units; do not constrain attachments. Source-unit count is not semantic-factor count.
